text: dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim 是面向 DSH Web 的适配插件，把 Cockpit 提供的端口转发接入 Memex 的浏览地址注册表。用户打开 Memex 卡片时，它按需获取对应端口的转发地址，并等待转发就绪后交给浏览器；本地设备场景下可回退到 localhost。插件监听两端服务的变化并在解绑时清理注册与转发句柄，适合在远程设备上浏览 Memex 卡片。它通过 Cordis 服务连接 dsh-cockpit-bridge 与 dsh-memex，不需额外密钥。

dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim links Cockpit port forwarding with Memex card browsing in DSH Web. It acquires the requested port forward, waits for its address, and returns it to the browser. Local-device errors fall back to localhost; service changes trigger cleanup.
我想在远程 DSH Web 上打开 Memex 卡片，并通过 Cockpit 的端口转发访问对应页面。
Memex 卡片给出的 localhost 地址在另一台设备打不开，怎样接上 Cockpit 转发？
Route Memex card links through an available Cockpit port forward so they open from a remote browser.
dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim 的功能「远端浏览地址」：Memex 请求某端口时，插件获取 Cockpit 转发并等待地址就绪；本地设备错误时回退到 localhost。
dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim 的功能「服务生命周期同步」：插件监听 Cockpit 与 Memex 服务注册变化，服务解绑或插件停止时取消等待、注销地址解析器并释放已获取的转发句柄。

<!-- problem -->
When dsh-memex runs on another machine, its "open cards" button would point your browser at a `localhost` address that is not the memex host. This shim makes the button use the port forward that dsh-cockpit publishes, so the card browser opens at an address that really reaches the device.

dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim README · dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim：The only deployment-side coupling point: it registers the bridge's port forwarding into memex's generic browse-address extension. The sources and dependencies of the two ends never reference each other; removing the shim decouples them.

dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim README · Install：Install it next to both ends: [dsh-cockpit-bridge](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-cockpit) >= 0.6.1 (distributed as a GitHub Release tarball) and `dsh-memex`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-cockpit/releases/download/dsh-cockpit-bridge-v0.6.4/dsh-cockpit-bridge-0.6.4.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim
```

Then restart DSH web. Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim`.

dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim README · 0.2.0 behaviour and prerequisites：- Requires the bridge to provide `cockpitBridge.forwards` (the production deployment pins 0.6.4). The old `portForward` / channel register / publish contracts are no longer supported.
- No top-level `inject`; each service is read once with a full dotted name through `ctx.get()`, so any load order of the two ends works.
- It uses `acquire(devicePort, holder)`, single-flight per port; the holder carries a random binding id so that a late release from an old binding cannot affect its replacement.
- starting/retrying/paused states wait for ready through `onChange`, for at most 15 seconds. Only the current `handle.address.url` is delivered; no URL is cached and the shim does not retry by itself. After opening, the holder is kept so the tunnel is not reclaimed right after the tab opens.
- removed rejects the current wait and is not re-acquired automatically. The next explicit open can acquire again, including when the handle was deleted between two clicks.

dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim README · Verification：Independent package test/typecheck/build. The integration regression uses memex's real registry (which returns localhost when nothing is wired) rather than a fake registry that would hide mis-routing. It covers ready waiting, concurrency, address changes, removal, failure classification and the service lifecycle.

dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim README · Removal：<!-- section: removal -->
This shim connects two ends: the **`cockpitBridge.forwards` port-forwarding service** of `dsh-cockpit-bridge` and the **`dshMemex.browseAddress` registry** of `dsh-memex`. Their sources and dependencies do not reference each other; the shim is the only place they meet.

dsh-cockpit-memex-browse-shim README · Removal：Remove it when you no longer open memex cards across machines through dsh-cockpit, or when either end ships the integration natively: delete the manifest entry → `dsh build` → restart; neither end needs any migration. Rolling back to an older shim must also roll the bridge back to a version that provides the old service; never mix the 0.1.1 shim with bridge 0.6.x.
